name: cisco-umbrella-mcp
description: Every Cisco Umbrella v2 API call, plus MSP child-org switching, domain verdicts, list diffs, and fleet health.

cisco_umbrella_api_key.title: CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_KEY
cisco_umbrella_api_key.description: Sets CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_KEY for the Cisco Umbrella MCP server. Get a credential from https://dashboard.umbrella.com.

cisco_umbrella_api_secret.title: CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_SECRET
cisco_umbrella_api_secret.description: Sets CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_SECRET for the Cisco Umbrella MCP server. Get a credential from https://dashboard.umbrella.com.

cisco_umbrella_org_id.title: Child org ID
cisco_umbrella_org_id.description: Optional. Child org ID to act on from an MSP or Multi-org parent key (the same as --org). Leave blank to act on the key's own organization.

cisco_umbrella_base_url.title: Umbrella API base URL
cisco_umbrella_base_url.description: Optional. Leave blank to use https://api.umbrella.com. Set it only to point at a different host, such as a test server; credentials then go to that host.

cisco_umbrella_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
cisco_umbrella_token_url.description: Optional. Leave blank to use https://api.umbrella.com/auth/v2/token. It must be on the API host; a token URL on any other host is refused.

cisco_umbrella_oauth_scope.title: OAuth2 scope
cisco_umbrella_oauth_scope.description: Optional. Scope sent with the token request. Leave blank: an Umbrella key already carries the scopes it was created with.

cisco_umbrella_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
cisco_umbrella_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

cisco_umbrella_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
cisco_umbrella_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

cisco_umbrella_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
cisco_umbrella_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

cisco_umbrella_mcp_upload_root.title: MCP upload folder (optional)
cisco_umbrella_mcp_upload_root.description: Optional. Leave blank. Reserved for MCP file uploads: no Cisco Umbrella MCP tool in this release takes a file, so the server never opens a local path and this setting has no effect.

cisco_umbrella_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
cisco_umbrella_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Umbrella requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank; pick a customer with CISCO_UMBRELLA_ORG_ID instead.
